notes:
Madagascar administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 24 Region  
- Admin 2: 120 District  
- Admin 3: 1645 Commune  
- Admin 4: 17465 Fokontany  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 06 July 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 10 August 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 10 August 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 August 2009: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Office of the Pacific Islands](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rop).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
